test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf (a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf SELECT arrayMap(x -> if(x = number % 256, toUInt64(1000), x), range(256)) FROM numbers(10000)
test.query: SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(a) + arrayMaxIndex(a)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(indexOf(a, arrayMin(a)) + indexOf(a, arrayMax(a))) FROM array_min_max_index_perf FORMAT Null
